Package model.player.rule.capture

package model.player.rule.capture
Rules that find captures of pieces and of blockades (Chain of Responsibility).
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    BlockCaptureRule
    A blockade captures an opponent blockade of the same size (T-8).
    CaptureCheckRule
    Chain of Responsibility where each rule checks whether the moved piece captures something (rule 7, T-8).
    PieceCaptureRule
    A single piece that lands on a single opponent piece captures it (rule 7).
